name: Kamisato (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Kamisato town emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised character of angular strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Kamisato, a town in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 November 1971.

features.role: Kamisato town emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised character of angular strokes
